summary: Practise HACCP hazard checks, temperature logs, cleaning controls and traceability. Explore this five-day food hygiene course.
lede: Food hygiene training helps food handlers, kitchen supervisors and quality assistants control routine hazards from receiving through service. Learners map food flow, assess biological, chemical and physical hazards, monitor temperatures, and keep cleaning, allergen and traceability records, including corrective actions; the course uses Codex hygiene principles and HACCP to practise everyday controls rather than full management-system implementation.
audienceIntro: This food hygiene course is designed for people who handle food directly or maintain the checks and records that support safe preparation, storage and service.
modules: Codex Hygiene Principles in Daily Handling
Codex Food Flow and Receiving Controls
HACCP Hazard Analysis for Food Handling
WHO Five Keys and Personal Hygiene
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with food handling or food-service operations is useful. No programming is required; exercises use written records, checklists and basic calculations.
